Contact detail, issue #762.

All four boards are the reported viewport — 1107×662, rail shell, light theme. Every value is lifted from src/index.css, App.tsx and ContactDetailsModal.tsx rather than invented.

Crimson hatching = what the space is spent on today.
Green = what you get back.

220 × 435  →  422 × 779

Height +92%, width +79%. Nothing is added to the page to achieve it: the aside, the footer, the tall head and a 32px phantom scroll are removed.

The two you have not seen before are the deleted aside and the two digests coming off Overview. They are also the two that buy the most room.

Settled 2026-09-02.

· The aside’s content moves into Overview as designed. “Cared for by” is promoted into the 56px head, so the one glance-level fact stays on screen from every tab.

· “Lately” is dropped — it was the 3 newest interactions, a true preview of the tab beside it.

· “Prayers we’re holding” STAYS. It is not a digest: it is every OPEN prayer, and the Prayer tab shows answered and closed ones too. Dropping it would have made open prayers harder to find than they are today.
